🎯 Key points for quick navigation: 00:10 *🛞 Access the spare tire by lifting the cover and ensure it is fully inflated to avoid using a flat spare.* 00:30 *🚧 Safety first: Set out a reflective warning signal and chock the opposite wheel before changing the tire.* 00:42 *🔧 Loosen lug nuts before jacking up the car, as it is difficult to do so once the vehicle is elevated.* 01:20 *🦶 If lug nuts are stubborn, use your knee or foot for extra leverage to loosen them.* 02:10 *📚 Consult the owner's manual to find the correct place on the vehicle's frame to position the jack.* 02:50 *⏲️ Be patient and cautious when jacking up the car; never place body parts under the vehicle.* 03:35 *🔄 Remove the flat tire, carefully place it aside, and ensure it is not left in a traffic area if possible.* 03:55 *🔩 Center the spare tire on the wheel studs and tighten lug nuts by hand before securing them with a wrench.* 04:45 *🌟 Use a star pattern to give the lug nuts a final tightening after lowering the vehicle to ensure even torque.* 05:15 *🚗 Avoid exceeding highway speeds on a temporary spare tire and prioritize fixing the flat as soon as possible.* Made with HARPA AI
